dos.text: Check the visible getter rather than just hidden when determining if a tab is actually rendered, visible also folds in isOpen and the tab's group's isTabVisibleInGroup, so a tab can be unhidden but still invisible inside a collapsed group.

donts.text: Don't assign to tab.hidden directly, the class defines only a getter ("This getter makes hidden read-only") with no matching setter, so a plain assignment throws.
Don't read elementIndex on a tab that isn't currently visible, the getter explicitly throws "Tab is not visible, so does not have an elementIndex" rather than returning null.
